name: Supermarket VR
summary:
Welcome to Supermarket VR, the supermarket of the future! In this immersive VR experience, you'll travel to a space station where you can shop for groceries.

Supermarket VR is a fun and challenging way to train your cognitive skills in a virtual reality environment.
